bears.name: Chicago Bears
bears.summary: The Bears made waves this weekend, shipping defensive tackle Gervon Dexter Sr. to Atlanta in exchange for cornerback Clark Phillips III as part of their final roster cuts. Chicago will also open the 2026 season without one of its most important defensive backs, adding an early injury concern as Ben Johnson finalizes his 53-man roster.
